platform_packages.@unami/ui: packages/ui — design system, shell primitives, structural components (KPIGrid, MetricCard, PageHeader, DataTable, EmptyState, ErrorState, etc.)
platform_packages.@unami/shared: packages/shared — platform contracts: RBAC, Language, Pagination, Utilities, Auth validators
platform_packages.@unami/api: packages/api — typed HTTP clients for Edge Functions. UNCIP clients live here: uncip-children, uncip-alerts, uncip-schools, uncip-stations, uncip-timeline, uncip-media, uncip-notifications

apps.apps/uncip: UNCIP v2 — Child safety platform. ACTIVE. Owns domain/uncip/, shell config, all UNCIP modules.
apps.apps/admin: Moments admin. Owns domain/moments/, shell, admin modules. NOT our concern.
apps.apps/web: Moments public PWA. Owns public routing, domain/moments.ts. NOT our concern.
apps.apps/umkhandlu: Unami Control Centre. Read-only intelligence aggregation. NOT our concern.

monorepo.database_rule: ONE APP = ONE SUPABASE PROJECT. Non-negotiable. No shared tables, no shared auth.users across apps.
monorepo.edge_functions_rule: Edge functions are co-located with their app's supabase dir. UNCIP functions live in apps/uncip/supabase/functions/. The root supabase/functions/ is Moments ONLY.
monorepo.deletion_test: Deleting apps/uncip must leave packages/ compiling without modification. This is the constitutional proof of correct layer separation.
monorepo.scope_rule: When working on UNCIP, only touch: apps/uncip/, packages/api/src/clients/uncip-*.ts, supabase/migrations/009+, supabase/functions/uncip-*. Never touch other apps or their domain logic.
